record.title: Fujita’s conjecture
record.statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, and let $X$ be a smooth projective variety over $k$ of dimension $n$. If $L$ is an ample line bundle on $X$, then $\box{\omega}_X \otimes L^{\otimes \ell}$ is globally generated for every integer $\ell \ge n+1$, and is very ample for every integer $\ell \ge n+2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 17. Canonicalized from 5 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unbounded semi-effective orders with irreducible effective multiples
record.statement: Even assuming the SHGH Conjecture, does there exist a smooth projective surface $X$ carrying a sequence of primitive classes $F_n$ with semi-effective orders $k_n\to\infty$ such that, for every $n$, $k_nF_n$ is numerically equivalent to an irreducible curve on $X$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bounded negativity for complex line arrangements
record.statement: If $C$ is a complex line arrangement, must we have $H(C) \ge H(C_W) = -\frac{225}{67} \approx -3.36$, where $C_W$ is Wiman’s arrangement of 45 lines? Note that $C_W$ has 120 triple, 45 quadruple, and 36 quintuple points.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rationality and computability of Waldschmidt constants of singular points of plane curves
record.statement: Let $C\subset \mathbb{P}^2$ be a reduced curve, let $Z=Z_C=\operatorname{Sing}(C)$, and let $\widehat{\alpha}(Z)$ denote the Waldschmidt constant of $Z$. Must $\widehat{\alpha}(Z)$ be rational? Can it be computed? As a sample open case, take $C$ to be Klein’s arrangement of $21$ lines.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bounded negativity for irreducible plane curves
record.statement:
Let $C\subset \mathbb{P}^2$ be a reduced singular plane curve, let $Z_C=\operatorname{Sing}(C)$, and let $D_C$ be the proper transform of $C$ on the blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at $Z_C$. Writing
\[
H(C)=\frac{D_C^2}{|Z_C|},
\]
if $C$ is irreducible, must one have $H(C)>-2$ in arbitrary characteristic?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Brill–Noether theorem for sheaves on del Pezzo surfaces
record.statement:
Let $X$ be a del Pezzo surface of degree at least $4$, and let $H$ be the pullback of a line under the blowdown map $X	o\mathbb{P}^2$. Suppose $V$ is a general $(-K_X)$-semistable sheaf with numerical invariants $(r,c_1,\chi)$, and set $
u=c_1/r$. If $r\ge 2$, $\chi\ge 0$, and $
u\cdot H\ge -2$, then $V$ is nonspecial if and only if $
u\cdot C\ge -1$ for every $(-1)$-curve $C$ on $X$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17296), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform doubling for all compact connected Lie groups
record.statement:
Conjecture: Every compact connected Lie group $K$ is uniformly doubling; that is, there exists a constant $D(K)$ such that, for every left-invariant Riemannian metric $g$ on $K$, 
\[
D_{K,g}:=\sup_{x\in K,\,r>0}\frac{\operatorname{Vol}_g(B_g(x,2r))}{\operatorname{Vol}_g(B_g(x,r))}\le D(K).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17297), page 38. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Quantum optimal transport for qubits of arbitrary size
record.statement: For all $j\in\mathbb N$, an $j$-qubit is a state on the finite-dimensional $C^*$-algebra $A_j:=\bigotimes_{n=1}^{j}M_2(\mathbb C)$. The arbitrary-size setting is the CAR algebra $A:=\bigotimes_{n=1}^{\infty}M_2(\mathbb C)$ with state space $S(A)$, consisting of all positive functionals on $A$ of norm one. How do we transport qubits of arbitrary size “optimally”?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17297), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Fixed-point property for uniformly convex Banach spaces
record.statement: Every lattice in a connected simple Lie group of rank at least two has property $(F_X)$ for every uniformly convex Banach space $X$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/55](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17298), page 27. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Cost and the first \b2-Betti number of finitely generated groups
record.statement:
It is conjectured that, for every finitely generated group \(\Gamma\),
\[
\operatorname{cost}(\Gamma)=1+\beta_1(\Gamma),
\]
where the report has established the lower bound \(\operatorname{cost}(\Gamma)\ge 1+\beta_1(\Gamma)\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/55](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17298), page 42. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Algebraicity of RM values of rigid meromorphic cocycles
record.statement: If $J$ is a rigid meromorphic cocycle, then there is a finite extension $H_J$ of $\bb Q$—the “field of definition” of $J$—for which $J[\tau]$ belongs to the compositum of $H_J$ and $H_\tau$, for all RM points $\tau$ of $H_p$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17300), page 31. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Inverse realization of pre-Kuznetsov weights
record.statement:
The problem raised by Michel–Venkatesh is resolved as follows: for every weight function of the form
\[
h(\sigma)=\sum_{\varphi\in B(\sigma)}\left(\int_G W_\varphi(g)\,\phi(g)\,dg\right)W_\varphi(1),\qquad \phi\in C_c^\infty(G),
\]
there exists some \(f\in I(0)\otimes I(0)\) such that \(h(\sigma)=h_f(\sigma)\). The corresponding transformed weight \(\widetilde h\) is also described explicitly.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17300), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stückrad–Vogel conjecture
record.statement: For a local ring $R$ with equidimensional completion, there exists a constant $c$ such that $\c\bigl(R/I\bigr) \cleq c e(I)$ for every ideal $I$ primary to the maximal ideal of $R$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16768), page 7. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Harbourne's symbolic-to-ordinary power containment conjecture
record.statement: Let $R$ be a regular ring and let $I$ be a radical ideal of big height $h$. Then, for all integers $n\ge 1$, $I^{(hn-h+1)}\subseteq I^n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16768), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Localization of finitistic test ideals
record.statement:
Let $R$ be an $F$-finite Noetherian domain of characteristic $p>0$, let $\frak a\subseteq R$ be a nonzero ideal, and let $t>0$ be a real number. Is it true that, for every multiplicative subset $S\subseteq R$,

$$S^{-1}\tau_{\mathrm{fg}}(\frak a^t)=\tau_{\mathrm{fg}}\bigl((S^{-1}\frak a)^t\bigr)?$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16768), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Asymptotic linearity of regularity of Ext and Tor over complete intersections
record.statement:
For each $\ell\in\{0,1\}$, do there exist $a_\ell,a'_\ell\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ and $e_\ell,e'_\ell\in\mathbb{Z}\cup\{-\infty\}$ such that

(i) $\operatorname{reg}\!\left(\operatorname{Ext}^{2i+\ell}_A(M,N)\right)=-a_\ell i+e_\ell$ for all $i\gg0$?

(ii) $\operatorname{reg}\!\left(\operatorname{Tor}^{A}_{2i+\ell}(M,N)\right)=a'_\ell i+e'_\ell$ for all $i\gg0$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16768), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Breuil–Strauch-type conjecture for coherent cohomology of the Drinfeld tower
record.statement: **Conjecture 1.3.** (a) For all $n\ge 0$, $\mathcal O(\Sigma_n)^*$ is an admissible locally analytic representation of $G$. (b) $\mathcal O(\Sigma_n)^*$ always has finite length.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/8](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16770), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite length of the coherent cohomology representations of the Drinfeld tower
record.statement: For all $n\ge 0$, $\mathcal O(\Sigma_n)^\ast$ always has finite length.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/8](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16770), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Admissibility of coherent cohomology representations of the Drinfeld tower
record.statement: For all integers $n\ge 0$, $\mathcal{O}(\Sigma_n)^*$ is an admissible locally analytic representation of $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/8](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16770), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Asymptotic Ringel decomposition theorem
record.statement: For every sufficiently large integer $n$, the edges of the complete graph $K_{2n+1}$ can be partitioned into edge-disjoint subgraphs isomorphic to any tree $T$ with $n$ edges.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 2. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform dimension for forcing a red unit pair or a blue copy
record.statement: Erdős et al. asked whether, for every natural number $d$, there exists a natural number $n$ depending only on $d$ such that, for every $K\subset E^d$, every red/blue-coloring of $E^n$ contains either a red isometric copy of $\ell_2$ or a blue isometric copy of $K$. The report answers this negatively already for $d=1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 22. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Alon’s conjecture on universal random permutations
record.statement: For every fixed \(\varepsilon>0\), a uniformly random permutation of length \(n=(1+\varepsilon)k^2/4\) is, with high probability as \(k\to\infty\), \(k\)-universal; that is, it contains every permutation in \(S_k\) as a pattern.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 39. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kahn–Kalai expectation-threshold conjecture
record.statement:
There is a universal constant $K$ such that for every finite set $X$ and increasing family $\\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^X$, 
\[
p_c(\mathcal{F})\le Kq(\mathcal{F})\log|X|.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 54. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Spread-hypergraph formulation of the fractional expectation-threshold theorem
record.statement: There is a universal constant $K$ such that, for any $\[1m\ell$-bounded, $\[1m\kappa$-spread hypergraph $\[1m\mathcal H$ on a finite set $X$, a uniformly random $(K\kappa^{-1}\log \ell)|X|$-element subset of $X$ belongs to $\langle\mathcal H\rangle$ with high probability as $\[1m\ell\to\infty$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 55. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rapid mixing of Glauber dynamics for colorings at the ergodicity threshold
record.statement: A well-known conjecture is that Glauber dynamics mixes in polynomial time (rapid mixing) for every $k \ge \Delta + 2$ (and hence that there exists a polynomial-time approximation scheme for $k$-colorings for every $k \ge \Delta+2$).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 56. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Girth Ramsey theorem for induced cycles
record.statement: Given a graph $F$ and positive integers $r$ and $n$, there exists a graph $H$ with $H\longrightarrow(F)_r$ such that, for every $m\in[2,n]$, every induced $m$-cycle of $H$ is contained in an induced subgraph of $H$ which is isomorphic to $F$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 61. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of exceptional regular graphs without internal partitions
record.statement: For every $d$, there are only finitely many $d$-regular graphs with no internal partition.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 78. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Majority 3-coloring conjecture for digraphs
record.statement: Every digraph $D$ admits a coloring $c:V(D)\to\{1,2,3\}$ such that, for every vertex $v\in V(D)$, at most half of the out-neighbors $w\in N^+(v)$ satisfy $c(w)=c(v)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17464), page 79. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality of free Stein dimension and non-microstates free entropy dimension
record.statement: Does \(\sigma(X)=\delta^{*}(X)\) hold for every tuple \(X=(x_{1},\ldots,x_{n})\) of self-adjoint operators generating a tracial von Neumann algebra \((M,\tau)\)?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/12](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17475), page 60. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality of the higher pseudo-intersection and tower numbers
record.statement: For every regular uncountable cardinal \(\kappa\), is \(\mathfrak p(\kappa)=\mathfrak t(\kappa)\)? Here \(\mathfrak p(\kappa)\) is the least cardinality of a family of subsets of \(\kappa\) with the strong intersection property and no pseudo-intersection of cardinality \(\kappa\), and \(\mathfrak t(\kappa)\) is the least cardinality of a \(\kappa\)-tower.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703861), page 14. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Canjar ultrafilters at uncountable-cofinality stages
record.statement: For every $\alpha \leq \omega_2$ with $\operatorname{cf}(\alpha) \geq \omega_1$, does $\mathbb P_\alpha$ force that $\mathcal F_\alpha$ is a Canjar ultrafilter that is not nearly coherent to any $P$-point in $\bigcup_{\gamma<\alpha} V^{\mathbb P_\gamma}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703861), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Comparability of Thompson’s group under embeddability
record.statement: Does Thompson’s group $F$ have the following property: for every finitely generated subgroup $H$ of $PL_o(I)$, either $F$ embeds into $H$ or $H$ embeds into $F$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703861), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Linear order expansion of an uncountable \-homogeneous graph
record.statement: Suppose that $K$ is an uncountable, $\$-homogeneous graph which embeds every finite graph. Is there some linear order $<$ on $K$ such that $\ K,<\$ is also $\$-homogeneous?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703861), page 54. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of exotic group $C^*$-algebras for non-amenable locally compact groups
record.statement: Let $G$ be a non-amenable locally compact group. Does there always exist an exotic group $C^*$-algebra $A$ of $G$? Here $A$ is a completion of $C_c(G)$ for a $C^*$-norm satisfying $\|f\|_u\geq\|f\|_\mu\geq\|f\|_r$ for all $f\in C_c(G)$, and it is called exotic if both canonical quotient maps $C^*(G)\twoheadrightarrow A$ and $A\twoheadrightarrow C_r^*(G)$ are non-injective.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703863), page 8. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Coxeter quotients of automorphism groups of Coxeter groups
record.statement: For every infinite Coxeter group $W_{\Gamma}$, the group $\operatorname{Aut}(W_{\Gamma})$ virtually maps onto some infinite Coxeter group.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703863), page 14. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rational strong Novikov conjecture for countable subgroups of diffeomorphism groups
record.statement: For a closed smooth manifold $N$ and a density $\omega$ on $N$, prove the rational strong Novikov conjecture for every countable subgroup $\Gamma\leq\operatorname{Diff}(N,\omega)$, where $\operatorname{Diff}(N,\omega)$ denotes the diffeomorphisms fixing $\omega$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703864), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Indecomposability of derived categories of symmetric products of curves
record.statement: Let $C$ be a smooth projective curve of genus $g\ge 2$. For every integer $n$ with $1\le n\le g-1$, the bounded derived category $D^b(\operatorname{Sym}^n C)$ is indecomposable; equivalently, it admits no non-trivial semiorthogonal decomposition.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703866), page 11. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rationality of cubic fourfolds in the discriminant families \(\mathcal C_{6a^2+6a+2}\)
record.statement: Conjecture: For every integer \(a\ge 1\), every cubic fourfold \(Y\in\mathcal C_d\), where \(d=6a^2+6a+2\), is rational.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703866), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equivalence of NIP and uniform definability of types over finite sets
record.statement: For every language $L$, every $L$-theory $T$, and every $L$-formula $\\varphi(x,y)$, the following are equivalent: (1) $\\varphi$ is NIP in $T$; (2) $\\varphi$ has uniform definability of types over finite sets (UDTFS) in $T$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17465), page 19. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform bound for the number of rational points on a curve
record.statement: There exists a constant $c([F:\mathbb{Q}],g)\ge 1$, depending only on the degree $[F:\mathbb{Q}]$ and $g\ge 2$, such that, for every number field $F$ and every smooth, geometrically irreducible projective curve $C$ of genus $g$ defined over $F$, $$\#C(F)\le c([F:\mathbb{Q}],g)^{1+\operatorname{rk}(\operatorname{Jac}(C)(F))}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703867), page 35. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Integral universality of embedding-calculus invariants for classical knots
record.statement:
For every integer $n\ge 1$, is the evaluation map
\[
\pi_0\operatorname{ev}_n:\pi_0\operatorname{Emb}_{\partial}(I,I^3)\longrightarrow \pi_0T_n(I^3)
\]
a universal additive Vassiliev invariant of type at most $n-1$ over $\mathbb Z$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703868), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Tensor product property for cohomological support maps of small quantum Borel algebras
record.statement: The Negron–Pevtsova conjecture that the cohomological support maps for small quantum Borel algebras associated with all finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebras satisfy the tensor product property, namely $W(A\otimes B)=W(A)\cap W(B)$ for all objects $A,B$, is solved affirmatively.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703870), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of Cox-ring iteration for arbitrary klt singularities
record.statement: Can finiteness of the iteration of Cox rings, known for weakly Fano pairs and klt quasicones, be generalized to arbitrary klt singularities?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/24](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703871), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Sharpness of a low-moment bound for a short zeta-function integral
record.statement:
Conjecture: The upper bound in Theorem 1 is sharp. Namely, for all sufficiently large $T$ and $0\le q\le 1$, the quantity
\[
\frac{1}{T}\int_T^{2T}\left(\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}\left|\zeta\left(\tfrac12+it+ih\right)\right|^2\,dh\right)^qdt
\]
should have the same order of magnitude as
\[
\left(\frac{\log T}{1+(1-q)\sqrt{\log\log T}}\right)^q.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703872), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Asymptotic exponent of the linear programming sphere-packing bound
record.statement: The linear programming upper bound for the sphere packing density in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is $2^{-(\lambda+o(1))n}$ as $n\to\infty$, with $\lambda\approx 0.6044$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703872), page 45. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Fourier uniqueness from integer-radius spherical shells (nonradial case)
record.statement:
Suppose \(\Phi\) is a test function in \(\mathbb{R}^D\), which need not be radial. If
\[
\Phi(x)=\widehat{\Phi}(y)=0
\]
for all \(x,y\in\mathbb{R}^D\) with \(|x|^2,|y|^2\in\mathbb{Z}\), does it follow that \(\Phi=0\) everywhere?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703872), page 52. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Cellular decompositions for rigid quiver representations
record.statement: Every rigid finite-dimensional complex representation $M$ of a quiver $Q$ has property (C); equivalently, every quiver Grassmannian $\\operatorname{Gr}_{\\mathbf e}(M)$ attached to $M$, for every dimension vector $\\mathbf e$, admits a cellular decomposition (an $\[?]`\alpha`-partition into complex affine spaces). Here rigid means $\\operatorname{Ext}^{1}_{Q}(M,M)=0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17466), page 52. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Brown–Wemyss conjecture for finite-dimensional Jacobi algebras
record.statement: For one-vertex quivers, every finite-dimensional Jacobi algebra is isomorphic to the contraction algebra of a flopping curve.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17466), page 61. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Injective dimension of the Jacobson radical
record.statement: For every connected, non-semisimple Artin algebra $A$, with $J$ its Jacobson radical, the injective dimension of $J$ equals the global dimension of $A$: $$\operatorname{inj\,dim} J=\operatorname{gl\,dim} A.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17466), page 68. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Systematic construction of non-weakly Gorenstein algebras
record.statement: Let $A$ be a connected, non-semisimple symmetric Artin algebra, and let $X$ and $M$ be finitely generated right $A$-modules. If $\\operatorname{Ext}^{\ell}_A(X,M)\neq 0$ for some $\ell\ge 1$ but $\operatorname{Ext}^{i}_A(X,M)=0$ for all $i\ge \ell+1$, then the algebra $B:=\operatorname{End}_A(A\oplus X)$ is not weakly Gorenstein.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17466), page 69. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
